levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: «- واللفظ لابن نمير -» is a dash-marked note on wording and is left out; «قالا حدثنا» makes the two first names one level
«أن أبا النضر، حدثه» — rule 5: Abu al-Nadr is the source Ayyash names, so he is a link

Open question: «أن أسامة بن زيد أخبر والده، سعد بن أبي وقاص» — the father is the one informed; whether Sa'd is a link (the last transmitter) or only the recipient is not settled by the rules, so he is not added
«وقال زهير في روايته» is a pure wording variant and is left out
